Grain-ethanol at 82% utilisation; OPM 4–6%→11–14%; debt 397→234. Maize ₹30–32/kg vs ₹26–27 viability → spread under pressure. Standalone data.
Kill criteria: OPM <8% Q3/Q4; debt >₹300 cr; ethanol price not revised while grain high
Caveat: sourced from public screens — no proprietary edge (lesson L1). Pledges not confirmed from NSE SAST.
